build_cmd: echo 'No build step required; Godot 4.7 runs from source.'

_notes.score.per_mote_deposited: REQ TICKET-02 L67: +10 each mote DEPOSITED (not picked); renamed from per_mote to prevent confusion
_notes.score.per_second_left_x2: REQ TICKET-02 L67: +floor(seconds_left)*2; value is the multiplier 2
_notes.score.per_stun: REQ TICKET-02 L67: +5 per shade hit by pulse (was 20 in v1.0)
_notes.fall_enabled_v1: COMPAT: kept as false so Phase-1 regression tests that assume no fall still work when scenario overrides. Actual runtime uses fall_enabled:true
_notes.mote_initial_count_selection: ASSUME B1: 8 inner (r=12) + 12 outer (r=33, 0deg to 247.5deg); Out13-Out16 start empty
_notes.wind_dir_deg_calm: DECIDE C2: dir_deg is numeric; calm phase inferred from sim_tick, not from dir_deg==0
_notes.bounce_pad_tolerance_y: ASSUME B6: 0.5m vertical tolerance for pad contact; use swept contact with pad_top_y
_notes.drifter_idle_omega: ASSUME B14: heading rotates 0.5deg/tick giving circle R~3.82m; not a tuning constant
_notes.mist_spawn_points: OPEN B15: drifter spawn uses mist_spawn_points which are NOT mote spawn points; WorldDefs must define these separately
_notes.air_control: DECIDE C1: full air control; same accel/decel as ground; max 6m/s
